reviews.text: Rufus loves it! He's very, very happy! We highly recommend it!
Very happy with the doggy daycare! Our dog is so excited when he goes in. Excellent service. Highly recommended and great daily communication.

For days now I've been seeing how they take the dogs out for a walk in a hurry, only to come out and pee at the same door. Do they have to endure that much? That's not taking care of an animal that you've been leaving for hours somewhere thinking it'll be fine.

I take my dog ​​to Dogterra and she's happy there. She's a husky and needs a lot of exercise, and she comes out exhausted from playing so much during the day. The best part is that she arrives and goes right in on her own, pulling on the leash, without even looking at me. That says it all. They take good care of her and she always comes back calm. Highly recommended if you have an energetic dog.
A perfect place to entrust what I love most. Teo is very happy with you, and so am I!
There's no better place to leave a puppy and have them treated like family. We left our little Teo there and they were incredibly kind!

Honestly, since I discovered Dogterra, my dog ​​Nano is a completely different dog. He goes in happily and spends several days a week at the doggy daycare until I pick him up in the afternoon. They always send me videos of the activities and how he plays with the other dogs.

Many thanks to the whole team; their dedication is evident every day. I have nothing but praise for them.

It used to be a fantastic service, but in recent months it's left much to be desired. Our dog has several caregivers because he suffers from separation anxiety and can't be left alone. We know he requires special care, and Dogterra used to take this into account. However, he hasn't returned from any of the other three places that care for him the way he has from Dogterra. He comes back agitated, aggressive, and smelling of urine, which, I repeat, doesn't happen at the other places. I think it's because Dogterra has become so overcrowded. We used to leave very happy. The last time we left him there, they didn't tell us anything about his behavior, and we only received a video, which was of another Beagle, not ours. We noticed several strange behaviors, but because of our work, we absolutely need caregivers, and since we left him here so long ago, we had some confidence in them. However, they told us that he behaved very badly last time and that we should only leave him for a few hours to see if he could stay overnight. Upon receiving this response, we decided not to even try, since when we picked him up last time they didn't say anything about this or anything at all, really. It's a shame it's become so overcrowded and they haven't been able to properly manage the growth, because it really used to be a good place. On a positive note, one of the guys and a girl with light eyes did a great job; you can see the love they put into it.
Extremely overcrowded place, very stressed dogs. I don't recommend it.

Archie absolutely loves Dogterra! From the moment we arrive, he’s always excited to get inside and see everyone. It’s such a relief knowing he’s spending the day somewhere he’s happy, well looked after, and able to socialize and play.

The team are clearly passionate about dogs and genuinely care about the ones in their care. Archie comes home tired and happy every time — which is probably the best review he could give!

Couldn’t recommend Dogterra enough! 🐶❤️

This is a review to denounce this company's behavior towards the neighborhood.

They put out cardboard boxes and leave them all day, sometimes for days on end, stuck to their storefront.

The law clearly states that businesses must put their cardboard boxes out and leave them in front of their storefront after 8:00 PM so that the cleaning service can collect them at night.

But they put them out whenever it suits them and leave them there.

This behavior reflects very poorly on the company. If this is how they treat the public, it makes me doubt how they treat their customers.

Very bad.

I'm so glad I found this place! I think I discovered it on Instagram, and the first time I left my Woody, I did a two-hour free trial. This time, I left him overnight because we had a family celebration, and it was great. The guy who helped me when we arrived, named Andrew, was very friendly, and when I went to pick him up this Sunday morning, he was there too, and also super friendly. Thanks, Dogterra! 🤗

We left Carlitos at Dogterra for two days. We barely heard from him during that time. A two-second video of his morning walk and another in the afternoon. That was it. I don't know what he did at any point. When we picked him up, he smelled strongly of urine; apparently, he was peeing and pooping inside the kennel. (That's impossible for him unless he's been locked up for a thousand hours.) They returned him to me with his bed completely destroyed because another dog had ripped it up. (Neglected dogs.) But the biggest problem was when I realized they hadn't given him one of his meals. They were separated into individual bags, numbered and dated. Carlitos had just had stomach surgery. His meals and portions were very important, and I made that clear to them. It's a shame because I had complete trust in them, and it left a bitter taste in my mouth.

I left my dog ​​with them for 11 days, and the experience was excellent from beginning to end. From the very first moment, they instilled a lot of confidence in me. Throughout his stay, he was perfectly cared for, looked after, and happy, something that was immediately apparent when I went to pick him up.

They also kept me informed with videos and messages, which gave me a lot of peace of mind while I was away. It's such a relief to know your pet is in good hands and receives the same love and attention as at home.

I will definitely trust them again whenever I need to. I wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone looking for a professional, responsible, and truly loving dog boarding facility.

Thank you so much for taking such good care of Pluto!
That's great. My Ty wanted to come back, so that says a lot.
I would never leave my dog ​​in a place with 40 other dogs.

This place saved us! We adopted Mandi 4 months ago and had never used a doggy daycare before, so we were a little hesitant…
All the kids are wonderful, and we can't even walk around outside anymore because Mandi just wants to stay there, haha. The follow-up with photos and videos is fantastic. They're not just left in a room; they're stimulated with games and socialize a lot.

THANK YOU ALL! I recommend it 100%!
